senses.gloss:
अमु अमु, a pronominal base, used in the
declension of the pronom. अदस्.

अमुक, अस्, आ, अम्, a certain person or thing, any-
thing or person referred to without a name.

अमुत्र, ind. there; there, i. e. in what precedes
or has been said; there above, i. e. in the other world,
in the life to come; here.
—अमुत्र-भूय, अम्,
n., Ved. being there above or in the other world;
dying.

अमुत्रत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a future state,
being of the next world.
अमुर्हि, ind. at that time, then.

अमु-वत्, ind. like a person or thing referred to
without name.
अमुष्मिन् (loc. sing. of अदस्), in the other world.
अमुष्य (gen. sing. of अदस्), of such a one.

—अमुष्य-कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to the
family of such a one.
—अमुष्य-पुत्र, अस्, ई, m.
f. the son or daughter of such a one; of a good family,
of known origin.
—अमुष्यायण (˚य-अय्˚), अस्,
आ, m. f. offspring of such a one; of respectable birth,
of known origin.

अमू-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, or अमू-दृश, or अमू-दृक्-
ष, अस्, आ, अम्, like that, such like, such a one, of
such form or kind.

अमुक्त अ-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not loosed, not
let go; not liberated from birth and death; (अम्),
n. a weapon that is always grasped and not thrown,
as a knife, a sword, &c.
—अमुक्त-हस्त, अस्, आ,
अम्, one whose hand is not open (to give); sparing;
stingy; frugal, prudent.

अ-मुक्ति, इस्, f. non-liberation; want of freedom
or liberty.

आ-मुक्ति, इस्, f. liberation, the being let loose;
final liberation; (इ), ind. to the end of existence.
अ-मुच्, क्, f., Ved. non-liberation.

आमुच् आ-मुच्, cl. 6. P. -मुञ्चति, -मोक्तुम्,
to loosen, let go; to put on a garment.

अ-मुची, f., Ved. not unbinding, not setting at
liberty (epithet of an evil spirit).

अमुख अ-मुख, अस्, आ, अम्, having no
mouth.

आमुख आ-मुख, अम्, n. commencement;
prelude, prologue; (अम्), ind. to the face.

अ-मुख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not chief, inferior, or-
dinary.

अमुग्ध अ-मुग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, not con-
founded, not perplexed, not foolish.

अमूढ अ-मूढ, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. मुह्), not
infatuated, wise; not perplexed.

अमूर अ-मूर, अस्, आ, अम् (for अ-मूढ, q. v.),
Ved. without error or mistake, infallible, not ignorant,
not bewildered.

अमूर्त अ-मूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, formless, shape-
less, incorporeal, unembodied; (अस्), m., N. of Śiva.
—अमूर्त-रजस्, आस्, or अमूर्त-रजस, अस्, m.
a son of Kūśa by Vaidarbhī.

अ-मूर्ति, इस्, f. shapelessness, absence of shape or
form; (इस्, इस्, इ), formless; (इस्), m., N. of Viṣṇu;
(-अयस्), m. pl. a class of Manes, who have no defi-
nite form.
—अमूर्ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, formless.

अमूल अ-मूल or अ-मूलक, अस्, आ, अम्, root-
less, baseless; without support; without authority;
without material cause or origin; not fixed in the
earth; having locomotive powers; (आ), f., N. of a
plant, Methonica Superba Lam.

अमूल्य अ-मूल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, invaluable, not
to be purchased, priceless.

आमुप आमुप, अस्, m. the cane Bambusa
Spinosa Hamilt. Roxb.

आमुर् आ-मुर्, ऊर्, or आ-मुरि, इस्, m. (fr. rt.
मृ with आ), Ved. destroying, hurting.

आमुष्मिक आमुष्मिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अमुष्-
मिन्, loc. of 1. अदस्), of that state, being there,
belonging to the other world.

आमुष्यकुलक, अम्, n., आमुष्यपुत्रक, अम्,
n., Gaṇa to Pāṇini V. 1. 133.

आमुष्यायण, अस्, m. (fr. अमुष्य, gen. of
1. अदस्), son or descendant of such a one, son or
descendant of an illustrious person; (अस्, ई, अम्), well-
born, well descended.

आमूलम् आ-मूलम्, ind. to the root, by the
root, entirely, radically.
अमू-दृक्ष; for ‘आ’ read ई.
